text: [photo: the new reading corner]
Finally got the beanbags in 🙌 that rug from the thrift place was the best $40 I've spent all year
Oh, that looks lovely. Where did the lamp come from?
My classroom lol. It was in the closet, nobody was using it
Looks good. Kids will fight over those beanbags.
Already have a sign-up sheet
nice. is that the rug from the spring sale
Yes!!
My car got towed this morning, street cleaning and I forgot $140 and two hours at the lot
Oh no. Did you at least get the sign-in sheet photo first?
I did lol. The tow guy was not moved by it
ugh sorry. that's a bad morning
also who's doing mic setup for the concert on the 12th? i can take it if no one has
I have the 12th covered. Dustin, the 3rd-grade groups list is still open if you want it.
ok I'll look tonight
Anyone have the spring intervention group sheet? I can't find my copy
I'll send it. Are you still doing reading on Tuesdays and Thursdays?
Yes, and maybe a Friday if the kids in room 14 stay on track
[photo: the cat asleep in a box that used to hold the concert programs]
She's been in there since 6. I'm not moving her
